user_requirements: 设计电池监控系统软件组件

system_analysis.functional_decomposition: System consists of Battery_Sensor_Driver (hardware data acquisition), Battery_Monitor_Service (data fusion, SOC/SOH computation, alarm management), Battery_Evaluation_Service (SOC/SOH calculation refinement, thresholds, alarm generation), Battery_NV_Block (non-volatile storage for last states/configs), Battery_ECU_Abstraction (abstraction layer for ECU interactions). Each component exposes well-defined ports and interfaces, with decoupled data paths to enable scalable expansion to additional sensors or evaluators.
system_analysis.data_flow_analysis: Sensor_Driver outputs raw measurements (voltage/current/temperature) to Monitor_Service via SENDER-RECEIVER interface. Monitor_Service aggregates, filters and computes SOC/SOH, then passes results to Evaluation_Service via CLIENT-SERVER interface for further decision-making and alarm generation. NV_Block stores configuration and last known state; ECU_Abstraction standardizes access to ECU resources and acts as a boundary for hardware specifics.
system_analysis.timing_requirements: Sensor sampling at 100 Hz; Monitor cycle at 10 ms intervals; Evaluation cycle synchronized with Monitor outputs, alarms raised within 50 ms of threshold breach.
system_analysis.scalability_considerations: Design accommodates up to 20 components; interface-driven data paths minimize coupling; additional sensors/evaluators can be added by extending interfaces and maintaining compatibility; data rate targets ~ few kB/s per data path in typical operation.

component_plan.name: Battery_Monitor_Service
component_plan.purpose: Aggregate sensor data, compute SOC/SOH, manage alarms and expose processed data to evaluation service
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: Real-time data fusion, filtering, SOC/SOH estimation, alarm decision logic, and data formatting for downstream components; periodic processing with deterministic timing; state management for calibration and fault handling.

preselect.notes: Read raw sensor data from sensor driver

elements.notes: Read input data from sensor driver

preselect.notes: Send processed data to evaluation service

elements.notes: Transmit processed data to downstream consumers

runnables.notes: Monitors data and distributes to evaluation service

component_plan.name: Battery_Sensor_Driver
component_plan.purpose: Collect raw voltage, current and temperature data from hardware sensors
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: Periodically samples ADC channels at 100 Hz, converts raw values to engineering units, and publishes data to the monitor service.

ports.details: Interface to hardware ADC and to Battery_Monitor_Service

preselect.notes: Send raw measurements to monitor service

component_plan.name: Battery_Evaluation_Service
component_plan.purpose: Compute refined SOC/SOH, apply thresholds, generate alarms and provide status to monitor service
component_plan.behavioral_characteristics: Receives processed data, computes higher-level health indicators, enforces alarm policy, communicates results to monitor service.

preselect.notes: Fetch latest processed input for evaluation
Publish evaluated SOC/SOH and alarms to Monitor

interface_plan.name: Battery_Data_Interface
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Asynchronous sample-based streaming between sensor driver and monitor service; supports up to 100 Hz data pushes.
interface_plan.performance_requirements: Latency <5 ms from sampling to monitor ingest; jitter <1 ms at 100 Hz

interface_plan.name: Battery_Control_Interface
interface_plan.communication_pattern: Synchronous request/response for control and configuration between monitor service and evaluation service
interface_plan.performance_requirements: Response time <5 ms; max payload 64 bytes

connection_topology.component_connections: Battery_Sensor_Driver <-> Battery_Monitor_Service (via Battery_Data_Interface); Battery_Monitor_Service <-> Battery_Evaluation_Service (via Battery_Control_Interface)
connection_topology.data_flow_paths: Raw sensor data -> Monitor_Service (fusion/SOC/SOH) -> Evaluation_Service (final health decision) -> Alarm/Status update
connection_topology.control_flow_paths: Monitor_Timing triggers Sensor_Sampling and Data_Processing; Evaluation_Timing triggers SOC/SOH reevaluation and alarm status update

architecture_rationale.design_decisions: Modular separation of concerns: hardware access (Sensor_Driver) separated from business logic (Monitor_Service) and decision-making (Evaluation_Service). Interfaces chosen to minimize coupling: SENDER-RECEIVER for data path, CLIENT-SERVER for control. ROUND1 focuses on element_selection to enable Round2 ARXML generation.
architecture_rationale.tradeoff_analysis: Pros: flexibility, easier testing, scalable data paths; Cons: added data copies, potential latency from multi-hop processing.
architecture_rationale.alternative_considerations: Consider tighter integration with ECU abstraction to reduce layers; evaluate event-driven vs. timer-driven primitives for energy efficiency.
architecture_rationale.risk_assessment: Risks include timing jitter at high sampling rates, data loss under heavy load, and interface versioning conflicts; mitigations include buffering, versioned interfaces, and determinism guarantees in scheduling.
